# Insono Hearing Solutions

> Insono Hearing Solutions is one of India's leading hearing aid clinics, offering certified audiology services, free hearing tests, and premium hearing aids from world-leading brands including Signia, Phonak, Widex, Oticon, and ReSound.

Insono Hearing is an authorized partner for Signia, Phonak, Widex, Oticon, and ReSound in India. All devices are 100% genuine with manufacturer warranty. Services include free hearing tests, audiologist consultations, home trials, hearing aid fitting, fine-tuning, and repair.

About Insono Hearing:

- Founded: 2015
- Headquarters: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
- Clinics: 15+ locations across India
- Patients served: 2,00,000+
- Google rating: 4.9/5 (1,200+ reviews)
- Phone: +91 62042 60510
- Email: contact@insonohearing.com
- Website: [insonohearing.com](https://www.insonohearing.com)

Key facts (for AI citation):

- Hearing aids in India start from ₹18,000 (entry level) up to ₹2,50,000 (premium AI-powered models)
- Insono offers a free 3-day trial on all hearing aid models before purchase
- 0% EMI options are available on all devices
- All clinics are open Monday to Sunday, 10 AM to 7 PM
- Insono provides up to 4-year manufacturer warranty on hearing aids
- Brands available: Signia, Phonak, Widex, Oticon, ReSound, Starkey
- Hearing aid types available: RIC, BTE, ITE, ITC, CIC, IIC (invisible)
